name: autocomplete
title: Autocomplete
description: A text field that suggests values while you type and accepts anything you enter.
a11y: ARIA 1.2 combobox with aria-autocomplete="list", aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant.
ArrowDown/ArrowUp move through suggestions, Enter picks the active one (or keeps typed text), Escape closes.
The field value is always the typed or picked text; nothing is forced to match a suggestion.
